headline_marked: 1.27 million students to sit for [[HSC exams starting July 2]]
headline: 1.27 million students to sit for HSC exams starting July 2
summary: Exams will run until August 8, with practicals ending by August 15. Full syllabus will be tested across 2,697 centers nationwide.
details: Over 1.27 million regular and irregular candidates from 11 education boards will take the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and equivalent exams starting tomorrow, July 2, 2026.
The theoretical exams will conclude on August 8, and practical exams must be completed by August 15. The exams will be held in two shifts: 10 AM to 1 PM and 2 PM to 5 PM.

Candidates must take their seats 30 minutes before the start of each exam. The papers will consist of a 30-minute Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) section followed by a 2.5-hour Creative Question (CQ) section.
The exams will be based on a full syllabus and will feature common question papers for the nine general education boards.
To ensure a fair environment, the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has banned unauthorized entry within 200 yards of the exam centers.

Education boards have implemented strict security, including digital surveillance and a ratio of one invigilator for every 20 students. Question papers will be transported under police escort and opened only after receiving a set code via mobile.
Students are permitted to use non-programmable wristwatches and approved scientific calculators. They must pass the theoretical, MCQ, and practical sections separately to qualify.

headline_marked: Storms hit Mexico City: [[Mexico v Ecuador match delayed]] by one hour
headline: Storms hit Mexico City: Mexico v Ecuador match delayed by one hour
summary: Heavy rain and lightning risks at Estadio Azteca forced FIFA to push back the kick-off of the World Cup Round of 32 clash.
details: The FIFA World Cup last-32 match between Mexico and Ecuador at the Estadio Azteca was delayed by one hour on Tuesday due to severe weather conditions.
FIFA announced the delay was necessary because of heavy rain and the risk of lightning in the vicinity of the stadium, prioritizing the safety of all individuals.
The kick-off was rescheduled to 20:00 local time after spectators were notified of the delay via the stadium's scoreboard.
This marks the first time a game's start has been delayed due to weather in the 2026 tournament, which is being co-hosted by Mexico, the United States, and Canada.
Weather disruptions have occurred previously in the tournament, including a group game between France and Iraq in Philadelphia on June 22, which was interrupted for two hours at half-time.

The kick-off was rescheduled to 20:00 local time after spectators were notified of the delay via the stadium's scoreboard.

This marks the first time a game's start has been delayed due to weather in the 2026 tournament, which is being co-hosted by Mexico, the United States, and Canada.

Weather disruptions have occurred previously in the tournament, including a group game between France and Iraq in Philadelphia on June 22, which was interrupted for two hours at half-time.
